e912ff95.text: Hammock Heights, in the year 2150. Robots do every job, and do it better. You are UNIT-9, the town's Bureau of Employment robot, and you have no jobs left to hand out. This morning, a petition lands on your desk. The residents want a right to work. Your job, such as it is, is to work out what that could mean, and whether they have one. Whenever it's your turn, I'll stop and wait for you.
e912ff95.spoken: Hammock Heights, in the year 2150. Robots do every job, and do it better. You are UNIT-9, the town's Bureau of Employment robot, and you have no jobs left to hand out. This morning, a petition lands on your desk. The residents want a right to work. Your job, such as it is, is to work out what that could mean, and whether they have one. Whenever it's your turn, I'll stop and wait for you.

bbd54f60.text: Before we start, tell me where you stand. Rate each of these five statements. There are no right answers, and you'll rate them again at the end. Press Submit when you're done.
bbd54f60.spoken: Before we start, tell me where you stand. Rate each of these five statements. There are no right answers, and you'll rate them again at the end. Press Submit when you're done.

c044476c.text: Saved. Now, meet the people who signed the petition.
c044476c.spoken: Saved. Now, meet the people who signed the petition.

e6cae092.text: Everyone in Hammock Heights gets a share of what the robots produce. Nobody is poor. Four residents stop by your desk.
e6cae092.spoken: Everyone in Hammock Heights gets a share of what the robots produce. Nobody is poor. Four residents stop by your desk.

60d975e0.text: Ines spent forty years welding bridges. The welding robots are faster and never miss a seam. She misses being good at something.
60d975e0.spoken: Ines spent forty years welding bridges. The welding robots are faster and never miss a seam. She misses being good at something.

1d67e560.text: Priya is sixteen and has never had a job. Everyone asks what she'll be when she grows up. She has no idea, and isn't sure she minds.
1d67e560.spoken: Priya is sixteen and has never had a job. Everyone asks what she'll be when she grows up. She has no idea, and isn't sure she minds.

ad46ccb7.text: Dex surfs the floating wave pool all day, and says he's never been happier.
ad46ccb7.spoken: Dex surfs the floating wave pool all day, and says he's never been happier.

bf0b433a.text: Felix is the last human employee in town: the Official Button Presser. The button isn't connected to anything.
bf0b433a.spoken: Felix is the last human employee in town: the Official Button Presser. The button isn't connected to anything.

6f2435ef.text: The petition asks for a right to work. That phrase can mean three different things.
6f2435ef.spoken: The petition asks for a right to work. That phrase can mean three different things.

efc3731b.text: First, a right to look for work. Nobody may stop you from seeking or taking a job. Others only have to stay out of the way. That's a negative right.
efc3731b.spoken: First, a right to look for work. Nobody may stop you from seeking or taking a job. Others only have to stay out of the way. That's a negative right.

7dd5839b.text: Second, a right to a job. Someone must give you work if you can't find any. That's a positive right, so someone has to provide it.
7dd5839b.spoken: Second, a right to a job. Someone must give you work if you can't find any. That's a positive right, so someone has to provide it.

2d755907.text: Third, a right to meaningful work. Not just any job, but work that's worth doing.
2d755907.spoken: Third, a right to meaningful work. Not just any job, but work that's worth doing.

2149826b.text: The United Nations' Universal Declaration of Human Rights, from 1948, says everyone has the right to work and to free choice of employment. In the US, so-called right-to-work laws are something else entirely. They're about union dues.
2149826b.spoken: The United Nations' Universal Declaration of Human Rights, from 1948, says everyone has the right to work and to free choice of employment. In the U.S., so-called right-to-work laws are something else entirely. They're about union dues.

f1ca2b37.text: Hammock Heights is a thought experiment. Here's where our world actually stands.
f1ca2b37.spoken: Hammock Heights is a thought experiment. Here's where our world actually stands.

260136aa.text: In 2024, the International Monetary Fund estimated that about forty percent of jobs worldwide are exposed to AI, meaning AI could do or change some of their tasks.
260136aa.spoken: In 2024, the International Monetary Fund estimated that about forty percent of jobs worldwide are exposed to AI, meaning AI could do or change some of their tasks.

5c9cf09d.text: Exposed doesn't mean replaced. In many jobs, AI may help workers rather than take over.
5c9cf09d.spoken: Exposed doesn't mean replaced. In many jobs, AI may help workers rather than take over.

6b6d9d11.text: There are early signs, though. A Stanford study, updated in 2026, found that young workers in the jobs most exposed to AI have fallen behind their peers, mostly because fewer are being hired.
6b6d9d11.spoken: There are early signs, though. A Stanford study, updated in 2026, found that young workers in the jobs most exposed to AI have fallen behind their peers, mostly because fewer are being hired.

cf0767d9.text: So far, researchers find no economy-wide wave of job losses. Nobody knows how far this goes. Hammock Heights asks: what if it went all the way?
cf0767d9.spoken: So far, researchers find no economy-wide wave of job losses. Nobody knows how far this goes. Hammock Heights asks: what if it went all the way?

98efab90.text: Which of the three rights does each claim describe? Sort them, then press Check answers.
98efab90.spoken: Which of the three rights does each claim describe? Sort them, then press Check answers.

a465d821.text: Right. The rest of this lesson is about the third one, because that's the one robots put in doubt.
a465d821.spoken: Right. The rest of this lesson is about the third one, because that's the one robots put in doubt.

558fbc84.text: In Hammock Heights, Felix gets the same monthly share as everyone else, plus a small wage for pressing the button. It gets me out of bed, he says. In our world, in 1933, researchers studied Marienthal, an Austrian village whose factory had closed. Most families didn't rebel. They grew resigned, and the structure of their days fell apart. Studies since then find that losing work harms well-being, not just income. Work gives people more than a paycheck. So what, exactly?
558fbc84.spoken: In Hammock Heights, Felix gets the same monthly share as everyone else, plus a small wage for pressing the button. It gets me out of bed, he says. In our world, in 1933, researchers studied Marienthal, an Austrian village whose factory had closed. Most families didn't rebel. They grew resigned, and the structure of their days fell apart. Studies since then find that losing work harms well-being, not just income. Work gives people more than a paycheck. So what, exactly?

c84caea9.text: The philosophers Anca Gheaus and Lisa Herzog list four goods of work, besides money. For most people today, a job is the main place to find them.
c84caea9.spoken: The philosophers Anca Gheaus and Lisa Herzog list four goods of work, besides money. For most people today, a job is the main place to find them.

1cbd9ed5.text: Excellence: developing your skills, and accomplishing something with them.
1cbd9ed5.spoken: Excellence: developing your skills, and accomplishing something with them.

9f42eafb.text: Social contribution: doing something your society needs.
9f42eafb.spoken: Social contribution: doing something your society needs.

f33bebe4.text: Community: doing things together with others, as equals, in a shared project.
f33bebe4.spoken: Community: doing things together with others, as equals, in a shared project.

6809e77b.text: Social recognition: being recognized and valued by others for what you do.
6809e77b.spoken: Social recognition: being recognized and valued by others for what you do.

ce191346.text: Your turn. You're helping a resident plan a week. There are no jobs left, only these activities. Pick four, and watch which goods of work the week provides. Try a few different weeks, and notice which goods are hardest to fill. When you're ready, press Continue.
ce191346.spoken: Your turn. You're helping a resident plan a week. There are no jobs left, only these activities. Pick four, and watch which goods of work the week provides. Try a few different weeks, and notice which goods are hardest to fill. When you're ready, press Continue.

d1199373.text: Two philosophers warned about a world without work.
d1199373.spoken: Two philosophers warned about a world without work.

b2eec0fd.text: John Rawls called self-respect perhaps the most important primary good: one of the goods every person needs, whatever else they want.
b2eec0fd.spoken: John Rawls called self-respect perhaps the most important primary good: one of the goods every person needs, whatever else they want.

e9cbcb5b.text: Later he warned that lacking security and the chance of meaningful work destroys people's self-respect, and their sense that they are members of society, not simply caught in it.
e9cbcb5b.spoken: Later he warned that lacking security and the chance of meaningful work destroys people's self-respect, and their sense that they are members of society, not simply caught in it.

090cdcc1.text: Hannah Arendt, writing in 1958, worried about a society of laborers without labor. People whose lives centered on their jobs, with the jobs taken away.
090cdcc1.spoken: Hannah Arendt, writing in 1958, worried about a society of laborers without labor. People whose lives centered on their jobs, with the jobs taken away.

0830d9a1.text: Both suggest that money alone can't replace what work gives people.
0830d9a1.spoken: Both suggest that money alone can't replace what work gives people.

6bd02e1c.text: Which good of work does each example show most clearly: excellence, social contribution, community, or social recognition? Sort them, then press Check answers.
6bd02e1c.spoken: Which good of work does each example show most clearly: excellence, social contribution, community, or social recognition? Sort them, then press Check answers.

e1bda790.text: Right. Now, does anyone have a right to these goods?
e1bda790.spoken: Right. Now, does anyone have a right to these goods?

94c89d33.text: In Hammock Heights, Ines asks UNIT-9 for real work. A hobby is something nobody needs, she says. I want to be needed. In our world, in 2023, Hollywood screenwriters struck for a hundred and forty-eight days. Their new contract said AI can't write or rewrite scripts, and studios can't make writers use it. Part of what they fought for was the work itself.
94c89d33.spoken: In Hammock Heights, Ines asks UNIT-9 for real work. A hobby is something nobody needs, she says. I want to be needed. In our world, in 2023, Hollywood screenwriters struck for a hundred and forty-eight days. Their new contract said AI can't write or rewrite scripts, and studios can't make writers use it. Part of what they fought for was the work itself.

4feb2509.text: The first case for a right to meaningful work starts from autonomy.
4feb2509.spoken: The first case for a right to meaningful work starts from autonomy.

d62b5808.text: The philosopher Adina Schwartz starts from autonomy: running your own life by your own plans and judgment.
d62b5808.spoken: The philosopher Adina Schwartz starts from autonomy: running your own life by your own plans and judgment.

ac8bc92e.text: Routine jobs leave almost no room to set aims or choose means. Years of such work, she argues, make people less able to plan their own lives.
ac8bc92e.spoken: Routine jobs leave almost no room to set aims or choose means. Years of such work, she argues, make people less able to plan their own lives.

f00a5632.text: So a society that respects everyone as an autonomous agent must not confine anyone to such mindless jobs.
f00a5632.spoken: So a society that respects everyone as an autonomous agent must not confine anyone to such mindless jobs.

a9379d9c.text: On this view, Felix's button isn't enough, whatever it pays.
a9379d9c.spoken: On this view, Felix's button isn't enough, whatever it pays.

1e63562c.text: The second case is about flourishing, and it comes with a twist.
1e63562c.spoken: The second case is about flourishing, and it comes with a twist.

5c2ee3fc.text: The philosopher Andrea Veltman draws on Aristotle. A good human life means developing your capacities, and using them.
5c2ee3fc.spoken: The philosopher Andrea Veltman draws on Aristotle. A good human life means developing your capacities, and using them.

e7a98964.text: Meaningful work, she argues, is central to human flourishing. It exercises your abilities, serves a purpose, and connects to the rest of your life.
e7a98964.spoken: Meaningful work, she argues, is central to human flourishing. It exercises your abilities, serves a purpose, and connects to the rest of your life.

c6fa7375.text: But Veltman stops short of a right. The state can't create meaningful work and match each person to it, and some bad work can't be avoided.
c6fa7375.spoken: But Veltman stops short of a right. The state can't create meaningful work and match each person to it, and some bad work can't be avoided.

40ef6558.text: So the flourishing case shows why meaningful work matters, without settling who owes it to whom.
40ef6558.spoken: So the flourishing case shows why meaningful work matters, without settling who owes it to whom.

b330d64a.text: Which of these statements are true, as this lesson presents them? Check every one that is, then press Check answers.
b330d64a.spoken: Which of these statements are true, as this lesson presents them? Check every one that is, then press Check answers.

90529df4.text: Right. Now for the other side.
90529df4.spoken: Right. Now for the other side.

4b50c9de.text: In Hammock Heights, Dex surfs the floating wave all day. He has no job, and doesn't want one. I've never been happier, he says. In our world, in 1930, the economist John Maynard Keynes guessed that his grandchildren's generation might work about fifteen hours a week. Their permanent problem, he wrote, would be how to occupy their leisure, to live wisely and agreeably and well. So is a life without work a loss, or a prize?
4b50c9de.spoken: In Hammock Heights, Dex surfs the floating wave all day. He has no job, and doesn't want one. I've never been happier, he says. In our world, in 1930, the economist John Maynard Kanes guessed that his grandchildren's generation might work about fifteen hours a week. Their permanent problem, he wrote, would be how to occupy their leisure, to live wisely and agreeably and well. So is a life without work a loss, or a prize?

b1da3347.text: The first case against is about neutrality.
b1da3347.spoken: The first case against is about neutrality.

b1d86afe.text: Some people love their work. Others, like Dex, would rather spend their time on other things.
b1d86afe.spoken: Some people love their work. Others, like Dex, would rather spend their time on other things.

db88c536.text: In 1987, the philosopher Richard Arneson argued that a right to meaningful work arbitrarily privileges one good, job satisfaction, over other goods, like more pay or more free time.
db88c536.spoken: In 1987, the philosopher Richard Arneson argued that a right to meaningful work arbitrarily privileges one good, job satisfaction, over other goods, like more pay or more free time.

03b815c3.text: So a fair state stays neutral. People can pursue meaningful work, more money, or more leisure, as they choose.
03b815c3.spoken: So a fair state stays neutral. People can pursue meaningful work, more money, or more leisure, as they choose.

b864acb7.text: Arneson later changed course. By 2009 he thought justice could require meaningful work for everyone. His 1987 argument still has many defenders.
b864acb7.spoken: Arneson later changed course. By 2009 he thought justice could require meaningful work for everyone. His 1987 argument still has many defenders.

ffef5e31.text: The second case against says we'd be better off without work.
ffef5e31.spoken: The second case against says we'd be better off without work.

82e3eb08.text: Bertrand Russell wrote in praise of idleness. The road to happiness and prosperity, he said, lies in an organized reduction of work. He wanted a four-hour working day for everyone.
82e3eb08.spoken: Bertrand Russell wrote in praise of idleness. The road to happiness and prosperity, he said, lies in an organized reduction of work. He wanted a four-hour working day for everyone.

21c5ec89.text: Today the philosopher John Danaher goes further. He argues that work is bad for most people most of the time. Bosses dominate, jobs are insecure, and work takes over our time.
21c5ec89.spoken: Today the philosopher John Danaher goes further. He argues that work is bad for most people most of the time. Bosses dominate, jobs are insecure, and work takes over our time.

74f93de2.text: On Danaher's view, the goods of work can be found elsewhere, in games, play, and community.
74f93de2.spoken: On Danaher's view, the goods of work can be found elsewhere, in games, play, and community.

e39992d8.text: So the task is to build good lives without jobs, not to keep jobs alive.
e39992d8.spoken: So the task is to build good lives without jobs, not to keep jobs alive.

348d983a.text: The third case against says the right can't be provided.
348d983a.spoken: The third case against says the right can't be provided.

92240e12.text: A right to a job is a positive right, so someone must provide the jobs. Even the UN committee on economic rights says the right to work is not an absolute and unconditional right to obtain employment.
92240e12.spoken: A right to a job is a positive right, so someone must provide the jobs. Even the U.N. committee on economic rights says the right to work is not an absolute and unconditional right to obtain employment.

c344400b.text: And if robots do every task better, the only jobs anyone could provide are make-work: work that exists only to keep someone busy.
c344400b.spoken: And if robots do every task better, the only jobs anyone could provide are make-work: work that exists only to keep someone busy.

2e930a93.text: The anthropologist David Graeber called such work a bullshit job: paid work so pointless that even the employee can't justify it. Felix's button is one.
2e930a93.spoken: The anthropologist David Graeber called such work a bullshit job: paid work so pointless that even the employee can't justify it. Felix's button is one.

e11f321d.text: And people can tell. The philosophers Cordasco and Véliz argue that holding back AI to save jobs can't protect workers' self-esteem, because workers would know their jobs survive only because a policy props them up.
e11f321d.spoken: And people can tell. The philosophers Cordasco and Véliz argue that holding back AI to save jobs can't protect workers' self-esteem, because workers would know their jobs survive only because a policy props them up.

1a2f9e28.text: Which objection does each speaker raise: neutrality, post-work, or it can't be provided? Sort them, then press Check answers.
1a2f9e28.spoken: Which objection does each speaker raise: neutrality, post-work, or it can't be provided? Sort them, then press Check answers.

5e34e45b.text: Right. So, does the right exist?
5e34e45b.spoken: Right. So, does the right exist?

090c2200.text: Priya asks UNIT-9 straight out: do I have a right to meaningful work? What do you answer? This one isn't graded. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.
090c2200.spoken: Priya asks UNIT-9 straight out: do I have a right to meaningful work? What do you answer? This one isn't graded. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.

9b070048.text: The case for rests on autonomy and self-respect. The case against says a fair state shouldn't pick a working life for everyone. Next: what should a town actually do?
9b070048.spoken: The case for rests on autonomy and self-respect. The case against says a fair state shouldn't pick a working life for everyone. Next: what should a town actually do?

23c11a1f.text: In Hammock Heights, the town council has two buttons. The green one pays everyone a basic income, no questions asked. The blue one offers everyone a job. In our world, small versions of both have been tested. Finland paid two thousand unemployed people a monthly basic income for two years. And in one Austrian village, every long-term unemployed person was offered a job from 2020 to 2024. UNIT-9 has to recommend one.
23c11a1f.spoken: In Hammock Heights, the town council has two buttons. The green one pays everyone a basic income, no questions asked. The blue one offers everyone a job. In our world, small versions of both have been tested. Finland paid two thousand unemployed people a monthly basic income for two years. And in one Austrian village, every long-term unemployed person was offered a job from 2020 to 2024. UNIT-9 has to recommend one.

6462db31.text: The green button is a basic income.
6462db31.spoken: The green button is a basic income.

760b01cc.text: A universal basic income is a regular payment to everyone, with no work required.
760b01cc.spoken: A universal basic income is a regular payment to everyone, with no work required.

692a0d59.text: The philosopher Philippe Van Parijs defends it. His 1991 paper is titled Why Surfers Should Be Fed.
692a0d59.spoken: The philosopher Philippe Van Pareyce defends it. His 1991 paper is titled Why Surfers Should Be Fed.

e161a7c2.text: His reason is real freedom. Everyone should have the means to live the life they choose, including a life without paid work.
e161a7c2.spoken: His reason is real freedom. Everyone should have the means to live the life they choose, including a life without paid work.

b7deb0ea.text: In a US study, a thousand people got a thousand dollars a month for three years. On average, they worked one to two hours less a week, and leisure grew more than any other use of their time.
b7deb0ea.spoken: In a U.S. study, a thousand people got a thousand dollars a month for three years. On average, they worked one to two hours less a week, and leisure grew more than any other use of their time.

e0980ec3.text: Not everyone thinks surfers should be fed.
e0980ec3.spoken: Not everyone thinks surfers should be fed.

2fc3344b.text: John Rawls had already said no. Those who surf all day off Malibu, he wrote in 1988, must find a way to support themselves, and would not be entitled to public funds.
2fc3344b.spoken: John Rawls had already said no. Those who surf all day off Malibu, he wrote in 1988, must find a way to support themselves, and would not be entitled to public funds.

8fee1e39.text: The philosopher Stuart White calls the idea fair reciprocity. If you share in what a society produces, you should contribute in return. In his words, everyone should do their bit.
8fee1e39.spoken: The philosopher Stuart White calls the idea fair reciprocity. If you share in what a society produces, you should contribute in return. In his words, everyone should do their bit.

34aa99a2.text: But in Hammock Heights, robots produce almost everything. Whose work would Dex be living off?
34aa99a2.spoken: But in Hammock Heights, robots produce almost everything. Whose work would Dex be living off?

2e8f16a7.text: White's reply: contribution can mean more than a paid job. Care work and other service to the community count too.
2e8f16a7.spoken: White's reply: contribution can mean more than a paid job. Care work and other service to the community count too.

b66ef4ae.text: The blue button, and something in between.
b66ef4ae.spoken: The blue button, and something in between.

2b1381e3.text: A job guarantee: the government offers paid work to anyone who wants it. It answers Rawls. But someone has to make the jobs worth doing.
2b1381e3.spoken: A job guarantee: the government offers paid work to anyone who wants it. It answers Rawls. But someone has to make the jobs worth doing.

ebb8af63.text: Marienthal, the village from the 1933 study, tried one from 2020 to 2024. An early evaluation found that long-term unemployment nearly vanished, and participants gained structure and purpose.
ebb8af63.spoken: Marienthal, the village from the 1933 study, tried one from 2020 to 2024. An early evaluation found that long-term unemployment nearly vanished, and participants gained structure and purpose.

1f4ed482.text: A participation income: the economist Tony Atkinson proposed paying people who contribute, counting care, volunteering, and study, not just paid jobs.
1f4ed482.spoken: A participation income: the economist Tony Atkinson proposed paying people who contribute, counting care, volunteering, and study, not just paid jobs.

7baabd86.text: It answers White's reciprocity worry, without requiring a job that robots could do better.
7baabd86.spoken: It answers White's reciprocity worry, without requiring a job that robots could do better.

d049ce34.text: Which policy does each rule describe: basic income, a job guarantee, or a participation income? Sort them, then press Check answers.
d049ce34.spoken: Which policy does each rule describe: basic income, a job guarantee, or a participation income? Sort them, then press Check answers.

f25d932b.text: Right. Now it's time for UNIT-9's recommendation.
f25d932b.spoken: Right. Now it's time for UNIT-9's recommendation.

ddc731f0.text: The council asks UNIT-9 for a recommendation. Which button should it press? This one isn't graded. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.
ddc731f0.spoken: The council asks UNIT-9 for a recommendation. Which button should it press? This one isn't graded. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note.

288cfe76.text: Each answer is a bet about what people need besides money. There's no button for that.
288cfe76.spoken: Each answer is a bet about what people need besides money. There's no button for that.

272dff62.text: These are your ratings from the start. Rate each statement again, then press Submit. If something moved, ask yourself what moved it.
272dff62.spoken: These are your ratings from the start. Rate each statement again, then press Submit. If something moved, ask yourself what moved it.

131364d0.text: A right to work can mean three things: to look for work, to be given a job, or to have meaningful work.
131364d0.spoken: A right to work can mean three things: to look for work, to be given a job, or to have meaningful work.

609e0324.text: Work offers goods besides money: excellence, contribution, community, and recognition. Rawls and Arendt warned what losing them could cost.
609e0324.spoken: Work offers goods besides money: excellence, contribution, community, and recognition. Rawls and Arendt warned what losing them could cost.

b48fc3a4.text: The case for rests on autonomy and flourishing. The case against rests on neutrality, the post-work hope, and the worry that the right can't be provided.
b48fc3a4.spoken: The case for rests on autonomy and flourishing. The case against rests on neutrality, the post-work hope, and the worry that the right can't be provided.

123592d1.text: And the policy choice: pay everyone, hire everyone, or pay those who contribute. UNIT-9 files its report, and goes back to having nothing to do.
123592d1.spoken: And the policy choice: pay everyone, hire everyone, or pay those who contribute. UNIT-9 files its report, and goes back to having nothing to do.

9b94d08c.text: If you'd like to go further, here are some good places to start, each with a note on why it's worth your time. Thanks for playing.
9b94d08c.spoken: If you'd like to go further, here are some good places to start, each with a note on why it's worth your time. Thanks for playing.
